details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: lines 52-140 (file now ends at line 140; entire `model_provider_broker_*` block was removed) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model-provider broker lifecycle and execution APIs were deleted while production callers still invoke them.
  WHY: Model-facing phases exit with `model_provider_broker_start: command not found`, and the credential-isolation boundary, request caps, model allowlists, and price ceilings are removed.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: line 668-670 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose invocation dropped brokered sanitized execution and now runs issue-derived content with `--sandbox danger-full-access` while `GH_TOKEN` and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` remain in scope.
  WHY: Prompt-injected diagnostic content can read or modify the workspace and exfiltrate credentials through filesystem or network access.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 152-180 (deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, `is_sensitive_target_path`) and `normalize_path` at lines 240-247 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering was removed, allowing issue- or plan-derived paths such as `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh/id_rsa`, and `.aws/credentials` to be read into model prompts.
  WHY: Credential-bearing files can be disclosed to the model provider.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: `_inject_token_into_url` (lines ~3038-3051) and `_resolve_origin_url` (lines ~3074-3087) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication embeds `GH_TOKEN` in HTTPS clone URLs after the per-process `http.extraHeader` mechanism was deleted.
  WHY: The token is exposed in process arguments, Git configuration, diagnostics, and logs, while other memory Git operations lose authentication.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: lines 137-180 (`memory_ensure_branch`), lines 542-602 (`_memory_force_tick_remote_url`), lines 594-604, 624-630, 767-773, 883-889, 919-925 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` was removed, direct Git operations run without authentication, and `_memory_force_tick_remote_url` embeds the PAT in the remote URL.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, memory branch operations fail or fail open, while token-bearing URLs expose credentials.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 493-498 (deleted `git_with_github_auth`); lines 732-952 (deleted all `review_blocked_*` functions, ~400 lines removed) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` and the review-blocked approval, successor, and decision helper APIs were deleted while callers remain.
  WHY: Review-blocked flows and authenticated judge-fix or baseline pushes fail with command-not-found or cannot complete terminal approval handling.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: REST `comments` projection at lines 766-772, GraphQL projection at lines 833-839 and final projection at lines 913-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized comment payloads no longer include `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked producer and approver verification cannot authenticate comments, leaving approval flows pending.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: usage string at line 7; option parser at lines 49-54; embedded Python option-handling at lines 127-132, 165-170, 229-237, 287-323, 331-351, 367-462 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` and the isolated process-group tracking and termination verification were removed while `review_apply_fixes.sh` still passes the option.
  WHY: Isolated editor launches exit with `unknown option: --process-group-file`, and surviving isolated descendants are no longer tracked or killed.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: lines 29-35 (docstring), 85-90 (USAGE), 95-110 (option loop), 143-148 (validation), 258-264 (printf'd base_url) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed while callers still pass the broker loopback URL, and `base_url` is hard-coded to the public OpenRouter URL.
  WHY: Config generation exits on an unknown argument, and callers that omit it can bypass the broker's model, token, request, and price controls.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: imports at lines 29-37 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module imports deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, and `is_sensitive_target_path` symbols.
  WHY: Pytest collection raises `ImportError`, preventing the targeted-context contract tests from running.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: lines 68-81 (Configure git auth for memory helper clones) and lines 86+ (the new `Fetch memory helper scripts` step) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `GIT_CONFIG_*` authentication exports are step-local and do not reach later memory-helper steps, while memory helpers no longer provide per-command authentication.
  WHY: Later `git ls-remote` and `git push` calls use unauthenticated origins and silently leave the `ai-memory` branch uninitialized.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: `emit_context` lines 540-716; specifically the `if used_bytes + raw_size > max_bytes:` branch | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Headers, missing/binary/overflow markers, and skipped entries do not consistently advance `used_bytes`, and the `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` cap was removed.
  WHY: Large untrusted path lists can produce output beyond the advertised total byte limit and inflate model context; severity disagreement exists between major and high source ratings, with the highest used.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 101-233 (new `staged_support_ledger` / `staged_support_base_dir` block) and lines 443-449, 580-585 (scope-guard `IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_RUN_DIR` switch) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER`, `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, and `IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_RUN_DIR` have no producer in the workflow.
  WHY: The staged-support restore protection is dead and scope checks fall back to the mutable repository `scripts/` path.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: deleted isolated process-group identity, privileged kill, and survivor verification (former `_write_process_group_metadata`, `_isolated_group_has_members`, `_verify_isolated_group_stopped`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Isolated editor process-group metadata and survivor verification were deleted while cleanup still expects that ledger.
  WHY: `sudo` can exit while descendants keep FIFOs open, and cleanup cannot confirm that the isolated group has terminated.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: line 140 (`local token="${GH_TOKEN:-}"`) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A newly declared `token` variable is never read.
  WHY: It is dead code that signals the removed authentication wrapper was not restored and may trigger shellcheck.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh: lines 13-17 | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `LABEL_HELPERS_SCRIPT_DIR` may resolve from the caller rather than the sourced file when `label_helpers.sh` is sourced.
  WHY: The script can source `caller_dir/gh_helpers.sh` instead of `scripts/gh_helpers.sh`; severity is reported as major with low confidence.
- changelog.d/security-pass-cycle-6-immutable-support.md: filename and line 1 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The changelog fragment filename lacks the required numeric `<issue-or-pr>-` prefix.
  WHY: The fragment naming contract for collision-safe per-PR paths is violated, although assembly still matches the fragment.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 203-204 (`git merge-file -p -L "editor" -L "staged ${SCRIPT_REF:-support ref}" -L "HEAD" -- "${staged_support_path}" "${staged_support_base}" "${staged_support_head}"`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `git merge-file` argument order is disputed: one review reports that the labels and operands merge against the wrong base, while another reports that the order matches `git-merge-file(1)`.
  WHY: If the disputed interpretation is correct, editor changes can be dropped or branch content can be propagated incorrectly; the disagreement is unresolved.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: memory_ensure_branch at 151 and 180-184 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Authentication failures from direct `git ls-remote` and `git push` are swallowed by fail-open handling.
  WHY: Downstream memory reads can proceed as if initialization succeeded even though the branch was never created.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
